svg.title: Joint densities of two independent sources under three priors
svg.desc: Three contour plots of the density of two independent unit-variance sources. Under the Gaussian the contours are circles, so every rotation of the axes looks the same. Under the logistic density, whose cumulative distribution is the sigmoid, the inner contours are nearly round and the outer ones become diamonds pointing along the axes. Under the Laplace density every contour is a diamond.
